description: This file contains functions and classes related to processing, analyzing, and generating synthetic time budgets for behavioral observation data within the BORIS project. It includes data aggregation, statistical calculations, and time interval analysis, primarily aimed at behavioral categorization and duration analysis.

classes.name: StdevFunc
classes.description: Class to implement standard deviation calculation compatible with SQL aggregation functions

methods.name: default_value(ethogram: dict, behavior_code: str, param)
methods.description: Returns default duration or proportion values based on behavior type and parameter queried.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary with subjects, behavior-modifier combinations, and parameters, setting default values.

methods.name: dict init_behav_modif_bin(ethogram: dict, selected_subjects: list, distinct_behav_modif: list, parameters: dict)
methods.description: Initializes a nested dictionary with subject and behavior modifiers, setting default parameter values.

methods.name: StdevFunc.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an object to compute standard deviation in an incremental fashion.

methods.name: StdevFunc.step
methods.description: Accumulates data points for standard deviation calculation.

methods.name: StdevFunc.finalize
methods.description: Computes and returns the standard deviation based on accumulated data.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget_bin(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Creates synthetic time budgets divided into time bins, calculating durations, counts, and proportions for behaviors per time bin.

methods.name: synthetic_time_budget(pj: dict, selected_observations: list, parameters_obs: dict)
methods.description: Generates a synthetic time budget for a project, aggregating behaviors over observations.

methods.name: Tuple[list,dict] time_budget_analysis( ethogram: dict, cursor, selected_observations: list, parameters: dict, by_category: bool = False )
methods.description: Analyzes time budget data extracting occurrences, durations, means, and standard deviations, optionally grouped by categories.
